integrity: The accompanying plain Python 3 script uses exact integer arithmetic; finite checks corroborate, but do not replace, the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim applies to simple generalized theta graphs with at least three terminal paths, each of length at least two; arbitrary unequal-length zero conditions are given as an exact finite subset criterion, not solved as a general closed-form Diophantine classification. A general signed forest generating polynomial in the primary literature may conceal an equivalent unindexed specialization; no independent audit has been performed.
title: A modulo-four recovery law for all-forest convolution on generalized theta graphs
